fix(ios): Honor Sentry.Mask in error screenshots (#6974)

* fix(ios): Honor Sentry.Mask in error screenshots

Register RNSentryReplayMask as a masked view class for screenshots so
<Sentry.Mask> is masked in JS error screenshots, the same as in Session
Replay. The native SDK only lets hybrid SDKs set the mask container class
on the replay photographer, not the screenshot one.

Fixes #6970

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(changelog): Link PR #6974

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ios): Gate screenshot mask class on replay support

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
